<b>Reserve Bind</b> is a {{CrestSlot|Blue|1}} in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It can be used to perform a single [[Bind]] without consuming [[Silk]], replenished at [[Bench (Silksong)|benches]].

== Usefulness ==
Allows for a single [[Bind]] to be performed without consuming [[Silk]]. When doing so, no Silk from the spool will be used, but the Tool's reserve will be fully used up. The Reserve Bind can be replenished only by resting at a [[Bench (Silksong)|Bench]].

When using the Reserve Bind, Hornet will quickly pull the Silk from its reserve before she begins Binding. This slightly lengthens the extra Bind's animation.
* Having a reserve ready does <i>not</i> activate [[Wanderer Crest]]'s ability to critically hit; 9 Silk is required as usual.
* If the [[Architect Crest]] is equipped, a Craft Bind can also be performed using the reserve. Its animation will still be lengthened by Reserve Bind.
* It can serve as an emergency heal for situations where Silk is scarce, like tricky platforming sections.
* Useful for shaking off [[Muckmaggot]]s while traversing [[Sinner's Road]], [[Bilewater]] or the [[Putrified Ducts]], especially if Hornet runs low on Silk. The Silk drainage from Muckmaggots also will not affect the Reserve Bind.

== How to Acquire ==
Given by the [[Second Sentinel]] in the [[High Halls]] after defeating it and completing the <i>[[Final Audience]]</i> [[Wish]].

== Trivia ==
* Replenishing the Reserve Bind at a bench does not consume any resources, despite Hornet using her usual crafting animation to reset it.
* When using the Reserve Bind, a white flash resembling the tool briefly appears over hornet.
